Aisha Khan: quick PSA - found a bundler interop footgun that breaks our JS SDK in edge builds. Happens with Vite and also when rollup is used directly. Node dev server works fine.

Aisha Khan: Symptoms: app deployed to Cloudflare/NF edge returns repeated 401 logs and client prints "missing auth header, retrying" until function times out.

Aisha Khan: Minimal repro I used:
1) npx create-vite@latest tiny-edge --template vanilla-ts
2) npm i ../local/redwood-inference-sdk (or install the beta)
3) src/edge.ts -> `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` + `const c = Redwood.createClient({ apiKey: RW_KEY })`
4) vite build && deploy to a worker/edge function

Tom B.: can you paste the built chunk? often rollup/cjs interop rewrites default-only exports.

Aisha Khan: Bundle snippet shows only named exports: `exports.createClient = ...` and no default object. dev server used native ESM and worked, but rollup/vite produce a CJS-esque chunk for the edge runtime.

Evan Li: This is the classic default vs named export mismatch. Vite/rollup + @rollup/plugin-commonjs will sometimes turn `export default` into `exports.default` OR into nothing if tree-shaken. Webpack has similar issues when `esModule` flag isn't set.

Jules M.: Workarounds we tested: 
- Use named import: `import { createClient } from 'redwood-inference-sdk'` (best for long-term)
- Fallback import: `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-inference-sdk'; const client = (Redwood.default || Redwood).createClient(...)`
- Rollup fix: set `commonjs({ requireReturnsDefault: 'auto' })` or `requireReturnsDefault: true`
- Vite: add `optimizeDeps: { esbuildOptions: { target: 'es2020' } }, build: { commonjsOptions: { transformMixedEsModules: true } }`

Tom B.: For webpack we had to enable `module.rules` to treat the package as ESM or use `babel-loader` to preserve `__esModule` markers.

Aisha Khan: There's an additional DX hit: TypeScript samples currently use `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-sdk'`. After bundler churn, types break in some editors (ESLint/TS plugin warnings) because d.ts only exports default but runtime yields named exports. Users get confusing errors on first run.

Evan Li: On the SDK side we can do two things: (1) emit both named exports and a default object in both ESM and CJS builds, and (2) in d.ts include `export =` or `export default` plus named exports so TS loaders resolve either style. That solves both runtime and typing.

Jules M.: I prototyped a tiny shim in dist/cjs/index.js: `module.exports = exports.default ?? exports` and it fixed the Vite + Netlify Edge repro. Also added `exports.createClient = createClient` earlier in the file.

Aisha Khan: Auth/retry nuance: when createClient fails to attach header (because import shape is wrong and `createClient` is undefined), our SDK currently treats the network error as transient and enters exponential retries. That ends up chewing edge CPU and hits provider limits. For edge we should short-circuit retries on auth failures (401/403) and log a clear hint.

Tom B.: agreed - immediate NACK for 4xx auth errors in edge contexts. And produce an error message that mentions the common bundler interop cause and suggests the `import * as` fallback.

Evan Li: I'll open a PR:
- Add CJS export shim `module.exports = exports.default || exports`
- Ensure ESM entry re-exports named + default (`export { createClient } from './client'; export default { createClient }`)
- Update index.d.ts to have both `export default` and named declarations and `export =` compatibility entry for `allowSyntheticDefaultImports` consumers.

Jules M.: I'll update the quickstarts to use named import and add a short troubleshooting note under "Edge bundlers" (Vite/Rollup/Webpack) with minimal config patches and the `import * as` fallback.

R&D-bot: Created ticket INF-4987: `sdk: edge bundler interop -> export shapes + 401 retry behavior` (priority: high). Linked PR #4021.

Aisha Khan: Attaching tiny repro to the ticket. TL;DR: recommend we ship export shim + typings fix + edge no-retry-on-401. This will save dozens of minutes for new devs and reduce noisy edge logs.

Tom B.: Thanks. if someone can run the patched dist through our smoke tests on NF/CF/AWS edge, ping here and i'll help validate.

Evan Li: I'll run it on Netlify and CF tonight. Will report back.

Jules M.: small note for release notes: call out "Fix: Edge bundlers could drop default export leading to missing auth headers and retries; SDK now exports both default and named API and avoids retrying on 401 in edge contexts."

Aisha Khan: Great. rolling the fix into the beta patch. Please @me if you see any other bundler oddities. :wave:
